_comment: Copy to scripts/havok/converter.local.json (gitignored) and keep ONE 'backend'. converter.py reads it; the skills only ever call converter.py.
_converter: The converter itself (GXOConverterAge3DE.exe + granny2_age3de.dll = GXO Exporter by Kevsoft, third-party, NOT part of this repo or its skills) has to be obtained from its author / the AoE3 DE modding community. Any tool that produces the same GXO text format works with the manual backend.
_wine-wsl: The exe under Wine inside a WSL distro (needed on PCs where Windows blocks the exe). Setup guide: the gxo-convert skill (kept out of git).
_native: Run the exe directly (only where it is allowed to run - never launch it on a Smart App Control PC).
_command: Any shell template; placeholders {exe} {opts} {file} {dir} {name}. opts are the converter's own switches (--format=gr2 --bang --modify-gr2=...).
_manual: No automation: converter.py prints the file, the options and the expected output path, then waits until the output appears (GUI drag-and-drop, 3ds Max / Blender plugin, web converter). The pipeline still works, just with a human step.
